style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

units.en: One Nation Under Atatürk, IndivisibleAs non-aligned Turkey, have zero negative state modifiers.
Playing as Turkey Battle for the Bosporus is enabled

Ruling party is Non-Aligned Has any negative state modifiers: Kurdish Agitation Kurdish Separatism Kurdish Rebellion Traditionalist Opposition Traditionalist Sedition Traditionalist Insurgency Kemalist Schemers
Has any negative state modifiers: Kurdish Agitation Kurdish Separatism Kurdish Rebellion Traditionalist Opposition Traditionalist Sedition Traditionalist Insurgency Kemalist Schemers

Go the Kemalist route through the Continue the Policy of Etatism and Peace at Home focuses. Take the Silent Workhorse advisor and use the Secularism decision whenever available to block the expansion of your Islamist rivals. Türk Ulusu focus will pacify the Kurdish states, while the Islamist opposition can be dealt with through the Counter-Fundamentalist Operation or compromise decisions (as long as the Kemalist remain loyal). You do not have to go to war and simply need enough political power to repeat the decisions. The achievement will trigger when all Islamic states are Placated, and the Kurdish states are either at Separatist Fatigue or cored. Alternatively, follow the Ottoman route, participate in WW2, and be defeated. Since Kurdistan will be established in the East, the negative Kurdish modifiers will be removed.
Master PuppeteerAs Bulgaria, complete the focus The Fate of the Balkans while having 5 or more Balkan puppets.

Has completed focus The Fate of the Balkans At least 6 of the following is a subject of Bulgaria: Romania Yugoslavia Hungary Greece Albania Serbia Turkey Slovenia Bosnia Herzegovina Macedonia Independent State of Croatia Kosovo Republic of Montenegro
At least ⟦0⟧ of the following is a subject of ⟦1⟧:
Romania Yugoslavia Hungary Greece Albania Serbia Turkey Slovenia Bosnia Herzegovina Macedonia Independent State of Croatia Kosovo Republic of Montenegro

After completing The Fate of the Balkans you get the ability to peacefully puppet any nation with a Balkan capital who is in your faction, as well as the capacity to force them into your faction if they are not already in one. A puppeted Yugoslavia can be integrated with its constituent states released as puppets for this achievement, or you can seize 803 (106) from them via decision. These states can make the puppets Macedonia and Serbia. In order to get states to join your faction via decision it is important to have more manpower deployed to the field, and puppet expeditionary forces contribute to this number.
At least they run on time!As fascist Italy, have max level railways in all your core states

Has railway of level ⟦0⟧ in: Sardegna (114) Piemonte (158) Lombardia (159) Alto Adige (39) Trentino (850) Veneto (160) Litorale (736) Istria (852) Emilia Romagna (161) Abruzzo (157) Toscana (162) Lazio (2) Campania (117) Calabria (156) Puglia (849) Sicilia (115)
Only a single province per state needs a level 5 railway. By making the connecting level 5 rail run through two states it counts for both.

Capitulated the ⟦0⟧ without taking the city of Stalingrad or having troops in any province in its state

It is recommended to use spies to create a Collaboration Government and lower the stability of the ⟦0⟧ to decrease their surrender threshold. Most easily done with historical focuses on, immediately justifying on Poland then once the war concludes justifying on the Soviets.

Habsburgs. Habsburgs everywhereAs Poland, install a Habsburg monarch and be in a faction with another Habsburg monarch.
Karl Albrecht I is the current country leader Hungary has Otto von Habsburg as the current country leader Is in Faction with Hungary

Karl Albrecht I can be elected king after choosing Assemble the Regency Council and then Fulfil the 5th of November Act. The Soldier King, The King's Guard and Press the Habsburg Claim will put Otto von Habsburg on the Hungarian throne, and completing A Habsburg Alliance will create the Habsburg faction.

Not a step back!As the Soviet Union never lose 1 core territory to anyone before 1945.
After Jan 1st, 1945 Has lost a core state

Note: Do not take the focus Reconcile Japan since North Sakhalin is your core! Turn off historical German focuses, leaving everything else on historical. Alternatively, declare war on Poland early, releasing Belarus and Ukraine as puppets while retaining your own cores and leave them outside of the war for an easier defensive line.
One Step ForwardAs Soviet Union declare a war on Poland and Germany before Germany attacks Poland.
Is at war with Poland Is at war with Germany Germany attacked Poland first

Set up a frontline along the Polish border. Justify on Poland, then declare war. Justify and declare war on Germany too. You will get the achievement when you are at war with both Poland and Germany at the same time.

Elect the Fascist king, join the Axis, and help them in the Africa campaign. As you only need to control Jerusalem, simply gain enough war score and ask for the control of Palestine.

We don't really like statisticsAs the Soviet Union under Stalin, conquer Germany while suffering less than 1 million casualties total.
Iosif Stalin is the current country leader Has defeated Germany while taking less than 1 million casualties
Has defeated Germany while taking less than 1 million casualties

Germany must capitulate to you. If it capitulates to another faction and you don't see the popup, you won't get the achievement. Can be done in a historical playthrough, but it's easiest to achieve when Germany goes for Oppose Hitler. Attack the Monarchist (or both sides) before they can recover from the civil war. Something to note is that this number only applies to casualties taken from Germany; you can take as many casualties as you like from other countries you are at war with.
Race for GermanyAs the Soviet union, capitulate Germany after the fall of France before the Allies control one German core state.
Conquered Germany after the Fall of France, before any other country took a core state of Germany.

When Germany capitulates, all their core states have to fall under your control. France must be in the Allies and have capitulated. The earlier the war, the better your odds. Go down the Collective Security branch and pick Eradicate Western Fascism (mid-1939 to optimize the attack bonus). Refuse the Molotov-Ribbentrop pact, and attack the German when they close in on Paris. Collaboration Government in Germany could be helpful. Alternatively help Germany kill the Allies by naval invading the UK after the fall of France then kill Germany. It is safer but harder.
Siberian TigerAs Tannu Tuva, form Siberia.
For detailed strategies, see Siberian Tiger
Just proper ganderAs the Soviet Union, activate 30 propaganda campaigns before 1945.
Completed at least 30 propaganda Campaigns After Jan 1st, 1945

Complete "The Path of Marxism Leninism", "Addressing Internal Affairs", "Expand the Agitprop", "The Komsomol" and then either "Positive Heroism" or "Collectivist Propaganda" to unlock the Agitprop decisions and expand to three slots. Continually take these decisions as soon as they are available to achieve 30 campaigns around five years after starting so make sure to start by 1939 just to be safe.
Around Eurasia in 80 daysMake a railroad from Gibraltar to Singapore.

For railways to connect, the provinces must be owned by members of the same faction. There are multiple possible routes to choose from. The route which passes through the fewest countries is Gibraltar - Spain - France - Germany - Poland - Soviet Union - Iran - British Raj - British Burma - Siam - British Malaya.
Poland Peasant RevolutionAs Poland, have the Peasant’s Strike overthrow the government.
Has completed focus Organize the Peasant's Strike Is not in a civil war Ruling party is either Democratic or Communist
Is not in a civil war

Simply take the focus Organize the Peasant's Strike and then take the decisions to claim provinces as well as the option to expand the strike to the factories. Having even a few provinces let’s you win the civil war easily.

After the Anschluss, you can justify a quick war goal on Germany using the claim on Vorarlberg. Doing this once the Allies have made a successful landing or two, you can fall back to a defensive line and simply wait.

Has 5 states not contiguous to each other after a peace conference
On historical, rush the Fascist path and join the Axis. As soon as possible, justify and declare war on Vichy France. Islands counts as non-contiguous states.
